snippet.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate – GhostsSoup Presents "Knuckles the Echidna"
snippet.description:
Knuckles the Echidna finally joins Super Smash Bros. Ultimate!

After years of work, Knuckles joins Sonic on the battlefield!

This mod comes packed with tons of content, as if Knuckles was his own actual DLC Character!

Coming from the Sonic the Hedgehog series, Knuckles brings a new stage, a Mii costume, spirits, music, and even an amiibo to the game, all based on content from Sonic Adventure 2, Sonic Heroes, and several other games!

Knock Knock!
Starting off with Knuckles himself, he brings the unique ability to glide through the air and climb up walls! He comes with alternate costumes based on the Sonic Riders series, his upgrades from the Sonic Adventure games, as well as a fan-favorite Treasure Hunter outfit sporting his favorite hat!

We at Pumpkin Hill, You Ready?
Knuckles’ stage is Pumpkin Hill, which first appeared in Sonic Adventure 2. This stage has a moving platform that goes back and forth, along with long walls on the side of the stage, perfect for Knuckles to climb up!

Pump up the jams!
Pumpkin Hill comes with 6 music tracks, all coming from various games! Please enjoy listening to them during your fights!

The Perfect Mii Costume
Next up, this mod comes with a brand new Mii Costume! Coming from Sonic Adventure and Sonic Adventure DX, comes Chaos Zero as a Mii Costume for Mii Brawler! Help protect the Master Emerald from the god of destruction!

amiibo!
As a first for modded characters, Knuckles comes with an amiibo! Included in the amiibo file are a .bin for rewritable amiibo objects, and a .nfc file to be used for a Flipper Zero! Train up Knuckles as if you were training a Chao in Sonic Adventure 2!

Take on the challenge!
Seeing as Knuckles is a new fighter, he also has a Spirit Board! Take on the challenge of several new spirit battles!

A few more things!
Knuckles may also have something for Palutena to talk about! Try visiting Palutena's Temple with Pit! 

Lastly, try out Knuckles in his classic mode route, based on rivals throughout gaming history!

Thank you to everyone that has helped and supported this project over the years. Without you all, this would not have been possible!

There are three different files to download.

The first one is the full mod. This includes:
-Knuckles fighter
-Pumpkin Hill Stage over the Photo Stage
-Spirit Board
-Chaos Zero Mii Costume
-Classic Mode
-Title Screen
-Custom Music
-Metal Knuckles replacement for AT and GHZ

The lite version includes:
-Knuckles Fighter
-Pumpkin Hill Stage over the Photo Stage

Finally, the amiibo download includes:
-.bin amiibo File
-.nfc amiibo File

DOWNLOAD KNUCKLES NOW!: https://gamebanana.com/mods/606587
